description: The sourced record of one material: sourced numbers with conditions, method and source location, plus uses, hazards, failure modes, corrosion and supply facts. Optionally narrow to one property or fact topic.

id.description: The id from search_materials, for example "lithium-iron-phosphate"

include_facts.description: Include uses, hazards, failure modes and other facts (default true)

property.description: Only claims for this property, for example thermal_runaway_onset

name: get_material
title: Get a material
